name: xxd-panel-109
title_zh: 半图切成几何拼贴的 50:50 海报生成器
tagline_zh: 照片只留一半原貌，另一半拆成克制色块的模块拼贴。纸纹压底，柔彩过渡，适合想给旅行照做展览级双联海报的人。
tagline_en: Keep one half of your photo intact; rebuild the other as a restrained modular collage with soft colors and paper.
desc_en: Turn each source photograph into a strict 50:50 top-bottom or left-right poster whose transformed half rebuilds its identity as a restrained, modular geometric collage with soft modern colour and paper grain. Use when the user invokes xxd-panel-109 or requests this exact independent Panel style.
why_zh: 它把一张图拆成两半，一半原封不动，一半用几何重构身份，像同一个人分饰两角。纸纹与柔彩让拼贴不显生硬。
why_en: It splits one image into two identities—raw and geometric—united by paper texture and muted tones, so the collage feels printed.
limit_zh: 只处理单张照片，输出固定 50:50 构图，不调比例、不换色板、不生成多版式。原图分辨率低于 2000px 时。
limit_en: Single photo only; fixed 50:50 split; no ratio, palette, or layout options. Under 2000px wide, collage details get soft.
title_en: 50:50 Poster Maker: Half Photo, Half Geometric Collage
